Perfect! All 283 tests pass. I've added the customer merge feature:

**Added `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` to src/customers.js:**

**Returns:** `ok({ customers, invoices })`

**Result:**
- Removes fromId customer from the customers array
- Updates all invoices belonging to fromId to belong to intoId
- Returns new arrays (doesn't mutate inputs)

**Validation:**
- ✅ CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND if either customer ID doesn't exist
- ✅ SAME_CUSTOMER if both IDs refer to the same customer
- ✅ Normalizes both IDs using `normalizeId()` (handles spaces, case)

**Example:**
```javascript
mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, 'C-001', 'C-002')
// Removes C-001, moves all C-001 invoices to C-002
// Returns: { ok: true, value: { customers: [...], invoices: [...] } }
```

**Added to src/errors.js:**
- SAME_CUSTOMER error code

**Tests cover:** basic merge, invoice movement, customer removal, other customer/invoice preservation, error cases (unknown IDs, same customer), ID normalization, edge cases (empty/full invoices), and immutability validation (15 tests).
